title: Anonymous payment RPC can mint unpaid Pro entitlements
evidence: Isolated PostgreSQL with original schema allowed anon to grant a test victim a yearly entitlement for amount=0. Repair denied it with SQLSTATE 42501; repaired migration applied twice successfully.
next_action: Inspect deployed overloads and permissions; review/apply 002 with database owner and test service-role functionality. Do not run the abuse probe against real users.

title: SEO group exposed AI spending and arbitrary server fetch to guests
evidence: Original /seo mount had no authorization; fetchPageContent allowed arbitrary HTTP(S), automatic redirects and unbounded response.text(). Group now requires admin + AI limiter; fetch pins checked public IPv4 DNS, validates every redirect and limits 2 MB/12 seconds.
next_action: Deploy and verify anonymous/ordinary sessions get 401/403. Public IPv4 only; IPv6-only pages are intentionally unsupported. DNS resolution itself can outlast the connection deadline.

title: BSE PDF redirect could leave approved domains; body unbounded
evidence: Original initial-URL check did not validate automatic redirect destinations. Regression fake redirect to metadata IP never contacted that destination. Stream without Content-Length rejected over cap.
next_action: Deploy; verify legitimate BSE attachments; 25 MB cap, HTTPS exact hosts, 3 redirects, 25-second shared deadline.

title: Paid/trial users could broadcast into shared Telegram channel
evidence: Manual filing, holiday and results-calendar sends used global destination without administrator-only guards. Authenticated ordinary and anonymous requests now rejected; UI manual handlers explain administrator requirement.
next_action: Deploy and check admin dispatch succeeds. Pro personal alerts remain a separate flow.

title: News and test delivery could select arbitrary/shared chats
evidence: News/digest now resolve stored personal target and reject mismatch/shared fallback. sendToTelegram rejects explicit personal target equal to global destination, including background/test calls. Saved arbitrary chat IDs still do not prove ownership.
next_action: Implement bot /start challenge with expiring signed nonce and bind Telegram chat to verified UID; allow only a completed binding. Test is delivery evidence, not identity verification.

title: Concurrent requests over-consumed AI quota
evidence: 110 concurrent requests against a 100-unit local budget allowed exactly 100 after per-UID serialization. Text UID admin no longer grants unlimited quota.
next_action: Keep the regression; distributed quota remains SEC-07.

title: AI quota is local to revision/instance
evidence: Usage lives in ai_usage.json on process.cwd()/data; process mutex cannot synchronize two Cloud Run instances or survive ephemeral reset.
next_action: Use durable transactional counter keyed by verified UID + IST day, idempotent generation ID and atomic reservation/refund. Test two replicas and restart before enabling scale.

title: One-time demo silently fell back locally on cloud RPC failure
evidence: Configured Supabase RPC failure previously fell through to local freeSummaryUsed; now throws store-unavailable rather than reissuing a demo.
next_action: Create/verify missing claim_free_summary_demo contract; confirm an outage returns retryable failure without consuming/generating. Local-only development remains non-durable.

title: Generation exceptions could refund quota twice
evidence: Inner and outer catches both refunded/released for announcement/news/company generation. Outer exception path now owns cleanup; null response has one explicit cleanup.
next_action: Add request-ID based distributed refund as part of SEC-07; verify Gemini throw/null/success paths in staging.

title: Ordinary users could toggle shared system alert presets
evidence: System IDs or UID text admin previously passed ownership exceptions. Toggle/delete now require strict owning user; preset system rules are immutable through user endpoints.
next_action: Dedicated verified-role admin management can be designed separately if desired.

title: Admin PIN is not a backend-required second factor
evidence: Verified owner Firebase token directly sets isAdmin=true; requireAdmin does not require evidence of PIN elevation. Existing authIdentity test intentionally verifies this behavior. Frontend isOwner also implies admin.
next_action: Choose whether PIN is cosmetic lock or required step-up. For real step-up: short-lived elevated JWT claim, middleware enforcement, raw Firebase owner never elevated, matching UI and recovery flow.

title: Logout/revocation do not invalidate stolen server sessions immediately
evidence: JWT lifetime is 7d; logout clears cookie only. Firebase ID token verification explicitly passes false for revoked checks. Browser stores auth/Firebase tokens in localStorage.
next_action: Shorter sessions and durable session versions/revocation; enforce Firebase revocation for sensitive flows; minimize JS-readable token retention. Test stolen pre-logout token after logout/revoke.

title: Optional reCAPTCHA can be skipped by omitting field
evidence: Session/PIN routes assess recaptchaToken only when supplied. verifyAppCheck/requireAppCheck exist but server mount does not apply enforcement.
next_action: Choose environments to enforce configured anti-abuse checks; fail closed on missing token there, retain explicit dev mode. These checks do not replace identity/authorization.

title: Session account lock key uses unverified request identifier
evidence: /session derives accountKey from body.email/body.identifier or shared default before verifying token. Rotating input evades per-account intent; targeting another email can contaminate its counter.
next_action: Bind post-verification limits to verified UID; separate pre-auth IP/risk key. Do not rely on unverified email for authenticated identity.

title: CSP and several browser isolation headers disabled
evidence: helmet disables contentSecurityPolicy, frameguard and multiple cross-origin policies; JS-readable tokens amplify an eventual XSS. Static FAQ JSON-LD sink alone was not an exploit.
next_action: Inventory required Firebase/Cashfree/AI Studio embedding origins, deploy CSP report-only, then enforce tested policy. Add nonce/escaping tests for dynamic SSR JSON-LD.

title: Dependency advisory backlog
evidence: npm audit: 16 vulnerable package entries, 6 high and 10 moderate, no critical. Firebase/Firestore/grpc/busboy/brace-expansion include high chains; entries are not 16 independent exploitable bugs. Dry-run did not remove alerts; tool suggested a Firebase downgrade.
next_action: Patch compatible transitive/direct versions in a separate reviewed change; test auth, PDF parsing, Cloud Storage and build. Do not force downgrade. Both npm and bun locks need one declared package-manager policy.

title: Repository SQL does not reproduce current payment/data contract
evidence: Backend calls grant_payment_atomic with 9 named arguments and expects pro_expires_at/already_granted/entitlement. Initial SQL provides 5 arguments and {ok:true}; order/entitlement column names and timestamp/status types also differ. Three additional RPCs and two tables are absent.
next_action: Run read-only schema-contract.sql on actual project. Write additive/backfill migration from real deployed state, test on copy, then deploy; do not overwrite existing live function with the old initial schema.

title: Entitlement repair has read-then-upsert race
evidence: reconcilePaymentEntitlement reads/merges then unconditionally upserts while atomic payment grant may update the same UID. No tested SQL compare-and-set protects repair.
next_action: Move reconciliation to row-locked SQL with monotonic expiry/order-set rules; race old repair against fresh purchase. Do not conclude current paid users are affected without reproduction.

title: Trial and upgrade surfaces do not share one verified eligibility view
evidence: Generic upgrade modal selects trial vs payment using local hasUsedTrial; server session grants trial by missing proExpiresAt; persisted trialUsed has no central atomic first-trial claim. Pricing purchase buttons now bypass trial modal into selected checkout.
next_action: Make trial eligibility and used status durable server truth; test registration retries, two simultaneous first logins, expired paid user, account deletion/recreation policy.

title: Manufactured financial filings populated empty real feed
evidence: Eight hardcoded company events were seeded with current timestamps and sample documents. Fresh isolated feed now returns []. Exact legacy fixture IDs are filtered from cache/cloud restore without deleting arbitrary filings.
next_action: Deploy; inspect whether those exact IDs are present live and clean only confirmed fixtures after export. A quiet source must display no data/staleness, not fictional filings.

title: Hardcoded prices looked like current market data
status: code fixed; source-age labeling still open
evidence: Frontend DEFAULT_INDICES and backend rolling seeds supplied exact numbers despite source failure. Initial state is empty; unavailable entries excluded; client failures with real cache mark stale.
next_action: Verify real quote timestamps. Server top-level lastRefreshed can still be now while individual quote is cached; badge needs per-source age threshold.

title: Invented FII/DII fallback numbers
evidence: No source/cache used to return invented negative/positive flows. Now returns null; missing/nonfinite fields rejected. Regression failed and incomplete responses returned null.
next_action: Render unavailable/actual source date; retain genuine cached data only with visible age.

title: Story defaults included fictional companies/financial narratives
evidence: Templates included sample earnings, deals, flows and movers. buildDefaultStoryChapters strips claims, captions, metrics, movers/actions and stock action pill until hydrated. Story API no longer substitutes invented index/FII values; valid zero changes preserved.
next_action: Remove unused fixture templates into a demo-only module later; separately test real hydration provenance and retained-cache age.

title: Gemini label can hide heuristic fallback
evidence: Missing API key can return a fallback extraction while UI uses Gemini/neural synthesis language. Response provenance is not a consistent field.
next_action: Return provider/mode/source coverage/cachedAt and label heuristic output; require full document evidence before claiming financial breakdown completion.

title: Market story close time/holiday sources disagree
evidence: Story moves switch at 15:00 IST while polling market-hours helper uses 15:30; holiday logic appears split between year-aware frontend and static backend lists.
next_action: Use a single dated exchange calendar/session service; test 15:00,15:29,15:30, holiday and Muhurat sessions against official announcements.

title: Telegram failed delivery was recorded as already sent
evidence: Meeting notified IDs were added before send result; manual filing was marked sent before dispatch. Both now mark only after successful delivery.
next_action: Test outage/retry and duplicate successful send semantics; durable outbox/idempotency is still needed across processes.

title: Notification persistence can disappear without caller noticing
evidence: Cloud writes are fire-and-forget and errors swallowed; missing notifications table in initial schema. Reads use local cache and initializer removes non-watchlist disk records.
next_action: Durable outbox/inbox transactions, explicit persistence failures and correct schema; test restart/two replicas/no-cloud and retention semantics.

title: One user marks shared notifications read for everyone
evidence: markRead APIs accept system/all notifications and update global isRead on the common record; no per-user receipt table.
next_action: Store user_notification_receipts(user_id,notification_id,read_at); verify A reads while B remains unread.

title: Filing link was overwritten after login/tab synchronization
evidence: Browser /filing/TEST/AUDIT-ID became a terminal path and FilingPage showed incomplete link. Guard preserves standalone/share URLs; all three fixture roles now retain full URL and show filing details.
next_action: Add real share/Back/Forward/refresh/SSR/client parity cases in staging.

title: Pricing route lacked component and purchase action drifted into trial
evidence: Client /pricing was recognized but never rendered. Added catalogue-based page; guest choice opens login and Pro/admin choice opens selected checkout. SSR paid links use action=checkout. Old tests expected obsolete free/499 pricing.
next_action: Test Cashfree sandbox end-to-end, selected plan preservation across actual sign-in and return URL; no real charge was made.

title: Save Note login host missing on standalone filing/results
evidence: Standalone share branch rendered NoteEditorHost but no AuthModal. Guest Save note → Sign in now displays login; Pro fixture opens New note editor.
next_action: Verify durable real note CRUD after real authentication; local fixture is not cloud sync proof.

title: Malformed escaped URL could crash application; settings refresh unknown route
evidence: decodeURIComponent unguarded on share path; parser now returns null for malformed escapes. /settings is recognized and initializes Settings tab.
next_action: Keep malformed URL test; browser test /settings refresh and Back/Forward across public pages.

title: Long duplicate username could hang deduplication
evidence: Suffix appended then whole candidate sliced to 25; a 25-character duplicate kept same candidate in unbounded seen-name loop. Base now reserves suffix length in both generators.
next_action: Test max-length collisions/reserved names and atomic cloud uniqueness; global registry uniqueness is still non-transactional.

title: Background history launch displayed completed counts
evidence: Single-stock route returns landed/message while UI expected newlySaved/totalHistoryCount and claimed +0 completed. UI now shows server message or honest requested-not-confirmed state; global admin-only actions explain guards.
next_action: Add jobId/status endpoint and per-user progress; distinguish requested, running, partial, completed and failed.

title: Security dashboard fabricated success/coverage
evidence: Prior hardcoded passed checks and network-failure-as-blocked simulation inflated assurance. Defaults are unverified; only observed JWT secret length can pass/fail; six read-only anonymous guard probes mark network/404/5xx inconclusive.
next_action: This is a basic access-guard probe, not a penetration test or ASVS certification. Use actual evidence per control.

title: Health latency was fabricated and mislabeled ingestion speed
evidence: Initial defaults were stable=85ms and connected=120ms; footer labeled request latency Live Ingestion. Initial health is now unknown/0 and footer says source request or unverified.
next_action: Measure publication→first fetch→durable save→API→paint→Telegram separately; remove any remaining hardcoded marketing latency claims.

title: Footer links overlapped fixed navigation/back-to-top
status: code fixed for targeted bottom-scroll cases
evidence: Initial geometry flagged footer centers under fixed elements. Added mobile bottom padding and desktop right reserve; 24 targeted bottom-scroll/action cases show no permanent footer obstruction. One remaining overlap involved an intentional notification prompt.
next_action: Review short-height/landscape/device safe areas, intentional dialogs and keyboard navigation on real hardware. First-viewport geometry flags are not all bugs.

title: Inspect button has no action handler
evidence: Inspect near approved diagnostic rules is a plain button without handler; six other plain button no-onClick occurrences are form submit controls and not automatically broken.
next_action: Implement detail view or remove/disable placeholder with clear description. Do not classify submit buttons as inert from onClick alone.

title: Mutation can report success for unknown watchlist ID
evidence: Rename/toggle DAO silently does nothing when owned list not found; route still returns success=true. User isolation is retained but outcome can lie.
next_action: DAO should return changed/notFound and API respond 404 for a missing owned record; test wrong ID and other user ID without leaking ownership.

title: Marketing unlimited/instant/free promises exceed verified behavior
evidence: Copy claims all Pro free, unlimited scrips/channels and seconds after publication while backend applies paid plans/100 daily AI budget/polling/circuit backoff. Landing contains explicitly SAMPLE rows plus other hardcoded dated narrative fixtures.
next_action: Audit visible copy against feature contract and provenance; label every illustrative dataset. Publish clear plan limits and measured latency percentiles, not guarantees.

title: Initial browser bundle remains heavy
evidence: Build initial index chunk about 1.63 MB / 419 kB gzip; server bundle about 968 kB. Route lazy loading exists, but eager landing/feed/auth/Firebase dominate.
next_action: Measure real mobile cold cache CPU/network with production asset server; split expensive landing visuals/optional dialogs/vendor code. No real-user LCP/INP budget was measured.

title: Polling/cache/backoff add visible filing delay
evidence: 20s backend market polling, 5m off-hours, blocked-source backoff 20/60/300s; frontend feed 30s; announcement server cache 15s and browser freshness/SWR; quote frontend 60s. Intervals overlap; do not add them as a guaranteed SLA.
next_action: Record event stage timestamps and p50/p95/p99 before changes; prioritize feed freshness over deep history/news calls, invalidate feed cache after new durable insert, consider SSE if measured bottleneck is client polling.

title: Authentication tests polluted shared local account counters
status: code fixed; two full runs passed
evidence: Repeated suite eventually yielded 429 instead of expected 401 and accountProtection case failed. Test files shared data/auth_account_limits.json across processes/runs. Those auth suites now use per-file temp directories and disable live Supabase credentials.
next_action: Keep state-isolated authentication suites; review other tests importing server.ts for scheduler/process-exit coupling.

title: Current republish precondition failure remains unverified
evidence: Screenshots show untitled/us-west1 in groovy-coda-l9v0l (confirm exact project ID); last successful publish Oct3 22:15:17 IST. Visible UpdateService version conflict around19:55 IST precedes that success, so it cannot alone explain later failed retry.
next_action: Use latest attempt timestamp and both Cloud Run revision + audit logs via cloudlogging link. Export current service/revision metadata and error status; do not delete working service or unpublish to diagnose.
